title: 諾曼第大橋
summary: 諾曼第大橋 1995 年通車時以 856 m 主跨創下斜張橋紀錄：主跨中央 624 m 為正交異性鋼箱梁，兩端各 116 m 與背跨為預力混凝土，184 根鋼絞線斜索掛在兩座約 214 m 高的倒 Y 形混凝土塔上。本課從混合主梁的重量配置、倒 Y 形塔的抗扭貢獻、斜索與樁基，經混凝土平衡懸臂與鋼節段吊裝，到現地風量測、長索振動與阻尼器加裝、斜索多層防腐與單股更換。
summaryEn: When it opened in 1995 the Pont de Normandie set the cable-stayed span record at 856 m: the central 624 m of the main span is an orthotropic steel box, while 116 m at each end and the back spans are prestressed concrete, and 184 strand stays hang from two inverted-Y concrete pylons about 214 m tall. The course runs from the weight layout of the hybrid deck, the torsional contribution of the inverted-Y pylons, stays and piles, through concrete balanced cantilevers and steel-segment lifting, to on-site wind measurement, long-stay vibration and retrofitted dampers, multi-layer stay corrosion protection and single-strand replacement.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼」與「倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span" and "Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「跨中 624 m 鋼箱梁」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Central 624 m steel box” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 諾曼第大橋的主跨 856 m 由三段組成：從塔向河中伸出的 116 m 混凝土懸臂，以及中央 624 m 的鋼箱梁。官方技術資料列出混凝土橋面每公尺約 33 至 50 t，鋼橋面只有約 8 至 11 t。斜張橋主跨的重量對塔的力矩與距離成正比，越遠的重量越「貴」：把輕的鋼梁放在力臂最長的跨中，把重的混凝土放在靠近塔、力臂短的位置，同時讓背跨的混凝土高架橋成為天然壓重。這種配置降低了塔與背跨錨固的需求，是當時能把跨徑大幅推進的關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「跨中 624 m 鋼箱梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The 856 m main span of the Pont de Normandie has three parts: a 116 m concrete cantilever reaching out from each pylon and a central 624 m steel box. The official technical sheet lists the concrete deck at about 33 to 50 t per metre and the steel deck at only about 8 to 11 t. Main-span weight acts on the pylon in proportion to its distance, so remote weight is the most costly: placing the light steel girder at mid-span where the lever arm is longest and the heavy concrete near the pylon where it is short, while the concrete back-span viaduct acts as natural ballast, reduces the demand on pylons and back-span anchorage. This layout was key to the large jump in span at the time. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Central 624 m steel box” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：半個主跨對塔的力矩 M = Σ w·l·x̄。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Half-span moment about the pylon M = Σ w·l·x̄.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大跨徑斜張橋的主梁全部用鋼最好，混凝土太重沒有用處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An all-steel deck is always best for long cable-stayed spans; concrete is just dead weight." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「跨中 624 m 鋼箱梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Central 624 m steel box”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The 856 m main span of the Pont de Normandie has three parts: a 116 m concrete cantilever reaching out from each pylon and a central 624 m steel box. The official technical sheet lists the concrete deck at about 33 to 50 t per metre and the steel deck at only about 8 to 11 t.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：大跨徑斜張橋的主梁全部用鋼最好，混凝土太重沒有用處。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An all-steel deck is always best for long cable-stayed spans; concrete is just dead weight. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span" is correct?
options: 大跨徑斜張橋的主梁全部用鋼最好，混凝土太重沒有用處。
諾曼第大橋的主跨 856 m 由三段組成：從塔向河中伸出的 116 m 混凝土懸臂，以及中央 624 m 的鋼箱梁。
塔的形狀只是外觀選擇，對橋面的抗風性能沒有影響。
optionsEn: An all-steel deck is always best for long cable-stayed spans; concrete is just dead weight.
The 856 m main span of the Pont de Normandie has three parts: a 116 m concrete cantilever reaching out from each pylon and a central 624 m steel box.
Pylon shape is purely aesthetic and does not affect the deck’s wind performance.
quiz.explanation: 諾曼第大橋的主跨 856 m 由三段組成：從塔向河中伸出的 116 m 混凝土懸臂，以及中央 624 m 的鋼箱梁。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The 856 m main span of the Pont de Normandie has three parts: a 116 m concrete cantilever reaching out from each pylon and a central 624 m steel box. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨中 624 m 鋼箱梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Central 624 m steel box” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：半個主跨對塔的力矩 M = Σ w·l·x̄。混凝土 116 m×40 t/m = 4,640 t，力臂 58 m，得 269,120 t·m；鋼梁 312 m×10 t/m = 3,120 t，力臂 116 + 156 = 272 m，得 848,640 t·m；合計約 1,117,760 t·m。若 428 m 全用 40 t/m 混凝土，M = 17,120×214 ≈ 3,663,680 t·m，約 3.3 倍。單位重取公開範圍內的教學值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Half-span moment about the pylon M = Σ w·l·x̄. Concrete: 116 m×40 t/m = 4,640 t at 58 m gives 269,120 t·m; steel: 312 m×10 t/m = 3,120 t at 116 + 156 = 272 m gives 848,640 t·m; total about 1,117,760 t·m. If all 428 m were 40 t/m concrete, M = 17,120×214 ≈ 3,663,680 t·m, about 3.3 times larger. Unit weights are teaching values within the published ranges. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析逐段累積塔底彎矩與背跨支承反力，與鋼、混凝土實際秤重或體積換算的重量比對；混凝土段每節以實際澆置量更新重量，鋼節段出廠秤重，偏差超過容許時調整後續斜索力或背跨壓重。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Accumulate pylon-base moment and back-span reactions segment by segment in the staged analysis and compare with weights from actual steel weighing and concrete volumes; update each concrete segment with its as-cast volume, weigh steel segments at the factory, and adjust later stay forces or back-span ballast when deviations exceed tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Half-span moment about the pylon M = Σ w·l·x̄. Concrete: 116 m×40 t/m = 4,640 t at 58 m gives 269,120 t·m; steel: 312 m×10 t/m = 3,120 t at 116 + 156 = 272 m gives 848,640 t·m; total about 1,117,760 t·m. If all 428 m were 40 t/m concrete, M = 17,120×214 ≈ 3,663,680 t·m, about 3.3 times larger. Unit weights are teaching values within the published ranges.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span", which statement holds?
options: 塔的基礎只要總承載力夠，兩肢之間的沉陷差不重要。
斜張橋懸臂每加一節，懸臂端的變形都相同，可以用固定的修正值。
半個主跨對塔的力矩 M = Σ w·l·x̄。
optionsEn: If total capacity is enough, differential settlement between pylon legs does not matter.
Each added segment deforms the cantilever tip by the same amount, so a fixed correction can be used.
Half-span moment about the pylon M = Σ w·l·x̄.
quiz.explanation: 半個主跨對塔的力矩 M = Σ w·l·x̄。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Half-span moment about the pylon M = Σ w·l·x̄. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨中 624 m 鋼箱梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Central 624 m steel box” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析逐段累積塔底彎矩與背跨支承反力，與鋼、混凝土實際秤重或體積換算的重量比對；混凝土段每節以實際澆置量更新重量，鋼節段出廠秤重，偏差超過容許時調整後續斜索力或背跨壓重。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Accumulate pylon-base moment and back-span reactions segment by segment in the staged analysis and compare with weights from actual steel weighing and concrete volumes; update each concrete segment with its as-cast volume, weigh steel segments at the factory, and adjust later stay forces or back-span ballast when deviations exceed tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：混合主梁的設計文件應列出每段的設計單位重、容許偏差與量測方式，並把鋼混分界處的重量與勁度變化納入施工控制；重量偏差超過約 3% 時須由設計者重新評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hybrid-deck documents should list each zone’s design unit weight, tolerance and measurement method and include the weight and stiffness change at the steel–concrete boundary in construction control; deviations beyond about 3% require reassessment by the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若混凝土段實際重量高於設計（例如超厚或模板變形），塔身與背跨錨固承受額外彎矩，跨中鋼梁的線形也會隨之改變；鋼梁若因設計變更增重而未重算，塔頂偏位與斜索力會偏離預測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If concrete segments end up heavier than designed, for example through over-thickness or formwork distortion, pylons and back-span anchorage take extra moment and the steel mid-span profile shifts; added steel weight from design changes not reanalysed pushes pylon-top displacement and stay forces away from prediction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段分析逐段累積塔底彎矩與背跨支承反力，與鋼、混凝土實際秤重或體積換算的重量比對；混凝土段每節以實際澆置量更新重量，鋼節段出廠秤重，偏差超過容許時調整後續斜索力或背跨壓重。
knowledge.textEn: Accumulate pylon-base moment and back-span reactions segment by segment in the staged analysis and compare with weights from actual steel weighing and concrete volumes; update each concrete segment with its as-cast volume, weigh steel segments at the factory, and adjust later stay forces or back-span ballast when deviations exceed tolerance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 混合主梁的設計文件應列出每段的設計單位重、容許偏差與量測方式，並把鋼混分界處的重量與勁度變化納入施工控制；重量偏差超過約 3% 時須由設計者重新評估。
knowledge.textEn: Hybrid-deck documents should list each zone’s design unit weight, tolerance and measurement method and include the weight and stiffness change at the steel–concrete boundary in construction control; deviations beyond about 3% require reassessment by the designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span"?
options: 以施工階段分析逐段累積塔底彎矩與背跨支承反力，與鋼、混凝土實際秤重或體積換算的重量比對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
斜索振動只是外觀問題，不會影響結構壽命。
optionsEn: Accumulate pylon-base moment and back-span reactions segment by segment in the staged analysis and compare with weights from actual steel weighing and concrete volumes.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Stay vibration is only cosmetic and does not affect structural life.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段分析逐段累積塔底彎矩與背跨支承反力，與鋼、混凝土實際秤重或體積換算的重量比對；混凝土段每節以實際澆置量更新重量，鋼節段出廠秤重，偏差超過容許時調整後續斜索力或背跨壓重。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Accumulate pylon-base moment and back-span reactions segment by segment in the staged analysis and compare with weights from actual steel weighing and concrete volumes; update each concrete segment with its as-cast volume, weigh steel segments at the factory, and adjust later stay forces or back-span ballast when deviations exceed tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨中 624 m 鋼箱梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Central 624 m steel box” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若混凝土段實際重量高於設計（例如超厚或模板變形），塔身與背跨錨固承受額外彎矩，跨中鋼梁的線形也會隨之改變；鋼梁若因設計變更增重而未重算，塔頂偏位與斜索力會偏離預測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If concrete segments end up heavier than designed, for example through over-thickness or formwork distortion, pylons and back-span anchorage take extra moment and the steel mid-span profile shifts; added steel weight from design changes not reanalysed pushes pylon-top displacement and stay forces away from prediction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種配置降低了塔與背跨錨固的需求，是當時能把跨徑大幅推進的關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This layout was key to the large jump in span at the time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大跨徑斜張橋的主梁全部用鋼最好，混凝土太重沒有用處。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An all-steel deck is always best for long cable-stayed spans; concrete is just dead weight." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若混凝土段實際重量高於設計（例如超厚或模板變形），塔身與背跨錨固承受額外彎矩，跨中鋼梁的線形也會隨之改變；鋼梁若因設計變更增重而未重算，塔頂偏位與斜索力會偏離預測。
knowledge.textEn: If concrete segments end up heavier than designed, for example through over-thickness or formwork distortion, pylons and back-span anchorage take extra moment and the steel mid-span profile shifts; added steel weight from design changes not reanalysed pushes pylon-top displacement and stay forces away from prediction.

steps.title: 倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「倒 Y 形混凝土塔」如何影響諾曼第大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inverted-Y concrete pylons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pont de Normandie”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩座塔高約 214 m、各重約 20,000 t，為預力混凝土倒 Y 形，兩肢向內傾斜，使塔以受壓為主。兩個斜索面從橋面兩側向上收斂到塔頂，從橫斷面看，斜索、橋面與塔肢形成三角形，橋面若要扭轉，一側斜索必須伸長、另一側縮短，斜索的軸向勁度因此直接提供扭轉勁度。這對主跨 856 m、寬約 23.6 m 的細長橋面非常重要，因為扭轉頻率與彎曲頻率的比值越高，扭轉顫振越不容易發生。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「倒 Y 形混凝土塔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The two pylons are prestressed concrete inverted Y shapes about 214 m tall and about 20,000 t each, with legs leaning inward so the pylon works mainly in compression. The two cable planes rise from both deck edges and converge at the pylon head; in cross-section, stays, deck and pylon legs form a triangle, so twisting the deck requires one plane of stays to lengthen and the other to shorten, and their axial stiffness directly supplies torsional stiffness. This matters greatly for an 856 m main span with a deck only about 23.6 m wide, because the higher the ratio of torsional to bending frequency, the less likely torsional flutter becomes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Inverted-Y concrete pylons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：塔肢軸力 N = V/(2cosθ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Leg force N = V/(2cosθ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔的形狀只是外觀選擇，對橋面的抗風性能沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pylon shape is purely aesthetic and does not affect the deck’s wind performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「倒 Y 形混凝土塔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Inverted-Y concrete pylons”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「倒 Y 形混凝土塔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inverted-Y concrete pylons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塔肢軸力 N = V/(2cosθ)。若塔頂合計垂直力 V = 400 MN、肢與鉛垂夾角 θ = 10°：N = 400/(2×0.985) ≈ 203 MN；若 θ 增為 20°，N = 400/(2×0.940) ≈ 213 MN，但肢底的水平推力 N·sinθ 由約 35 MN 增至約 73 MN，需由橫梁或基礎承擔。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Leg force N = V/(2cosθ). With a total vertical force V = 400 MN at the head and legs at θ = 10° from vertical, N = 400/(2×0.985) ≈ 203 MN; at θ = 20°, N = 400/(2×0.940) ≈ 213 MN, but the horizontal thrust at the leg base, N·sinθ, grows from about 35 MN to about 73 MN, to be carried by a cross beam or the foundation. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模態分析取得橋面一階垂直彎曲與一階扭轉頻率，計算頻率比並與風洞顫振試驗結果比較；施工中量測兩肢的垂直度與交會點座標，確認斜索錨點位置與設計一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the first vertical bending and torsional frequencies from modal analysis, compute their ratio and compare with flutter test results; during construction survey the verticality of both legs and the coordinates of their meeting point to confirm stay anchor positions match the design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「倒 Y 形混凝土塔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inverted-Y concrete pylons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以模態分析取得橋面一階垂直彎曲與一階扭轉頻率，計算頻率比並與風洞顫振試驗結果比較；施工中量測兩肢的垂直度與交會點座標，確認斜索錨點位置與設計一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the first vertical bending and torsional frequencies from modal analysis, compute their ratio and compare with flutter test results; during construction survey the verticality of both legs and the coordinates of their meeting point to confirm stay anchor positions match the design. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塔型選擇報告應同時列出頻率比、顫振臨界風速與塔肢內力的比較；塔肢交會區與錨固區的鋼筋、預力配置要以三維模型檢查施工可行性，避免混凝土澆置不密實。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The pylon-form study should compare frequency ratio, flutter speed and leg forces together; reinforcement and prestress at the leg junction and anchorage zone should be checked for buildability in a 3D model to avoid poorly compacted concrete.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低；塔肢交會處的局部應力若設計不足，預力或鋼筋配置不當會出現裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed; inadequate design of the leg junction leads to cracking where prestress or reinforcement is poorly arranged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低；塔肢交會處的局部應力若設計不足，預力或鋼筋配置不當會出現裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed; inadequate design of the leg junction leads to cracking where prestress or reinforcement is poorly arranged.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。
若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
As long as the total stay force is right, how force is shared among strands does not matter.
Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed.
quiz.explanation: 若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低；塔肢交會處的局部應力若設計不足，預力或鋼筋配置不當會出現裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed; inadequate design of the leg junction leads to cracking where prestress or reinforcement is poorly arranged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
